h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shivpuri

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shivpuri

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Shivpuri

c: Shivpuri has lakes, old gardens and Madhav National Park on its edge, so people here are used to spending time outdoors. For park committees, schools and government campuses that want to add exercise to those spaces, FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Shivpuri. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 830 km away, and sent to Madhya Pradesh by road.

Budget is often the deciding factor for a town park or a school, so we usually suggest a phased plan. Start with a few machines that cover the main muscle groups, then add more in a later financial year. Each Fun Fitness station has its own base, so nothing already installed has to be moved. Installation is by our team or a dealer in central India, and you approve a layout drawing first.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What is a sensible first set of outdoor gym machines for a small park?
items.a: Three or four machines that work the legs, shoulders and waist, such as a leg press, a tai chi wheel and a twister. These suit most ages and can be added to later.

items.q: Can you plan the full layout now and supply it in phases?
items.a: Yes. We can mark every planned station on one layout drawing, then quote and supply the first phase. The later machines fit into the spaces already planned.

items.q: What warranty comes with the machines?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, covering manufacturing defects under the installation and care we specify.
